title: v2.2.0 - Official Grok Bot Rebranding & Frontier Autonomous Teammates Alignment
release_notes:
### 🤖 Official Grok Bot Rebranding & Autonomous Teammates Alignment

- **Official Rebranding to Grok Bot (xAI)**:
  - Rebranded xAI's agent ecosystem from generic coding agent to official **Grok Bot** across all jump pills, section headers, meta badges, and release logs.
  - Specified Grok Bot's dedicated cloud-based virtual computer environment (integrated browser, sandboxed terminal, persistent filesystem, and 24/7 asynchronous routine execution).
  - Highlighted Grok Bot's autonomous demonstration-based learning, multi-bot team collaboration, and human-in-the-loop permission gates.
  - Aligned engine badge to 🧠 Grok 4.7 / Grok 4 and logged latest release 4.7.1.
- **xAI Grok 4.7 Flagship Alignment**:
  - Validated and integrated **Grok 4.7** (September 21, 2026 release) with 500,000-token context window (500K Tokens), multi-level adjustable reasoning (Low, Medium, High, XHigh), and native Cursor/Grok Build integration.
- **DeepSeek-V4.1 & Open-Weights R1 Frontier Alignment**:
  - Confirmed active commercial flagship as **DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash (1017)** (October 17, 2026, 1.0M context, Causal Encoder-Decoder CED architecture + CSA2) alongside **DeepSeek-V4 Pro** (1.6T MoE).
  - Explicitly differentiated and preserved **DeepSeek-R1** as the historic January 20, 2025 Open-Weights (MIT license) reasoning milestone.
- **Client Cache Invalidation**:
  - Bumped client storage keys to DASHBOARD_LIVE_MODELS_V5 and DASHBOARD_AGENT_RELEASES_V4 to ensure instant cache invalidation for all visiting devices.
